svg.text: ESP32-P4 case — sketch v4 (lid options and how it attaches)
All three: 2 mm plate, 5.5 mm solid frame, holes ≤ 3.5 mm (keeps fingers and M3 screws out), 1 mm walls.
stiffest for its open area; prints flat, no bridges
same open area; a bit less stiff diagonally
tidy look; slots flex along their length
E. Section through a wing (across the case)
lid sits in a 1 mm rebate on top of the walls (flush)
wing hangs 7 mm down the outside; its hook clicks into a notch
open: lift a wing with a fingernail
0.5 mm between the lid and the USB stack
Wing positions (Y = 10 and 40 mm, both sides) avoid the SMA on the right wall.
